title: SPECIESCOPE: A design for scope-specific, auditable estimates of Earth species richness
scientific_question: Given a declared species concept, scope, sampling frame, and estimator, what richness interval and uncertainty are supported?
prohibited_inferences: Do not equate OTUs, ASVs, or BINs automatically with biological species.
Do not add eukaryotic taxonomic species estimates to microbial sequence-cluster estimates.
Do not report a universal total if estimand passports are incompatible.

verified_key_sources.claim_boundary: approximately 8.7 million global eukaryotic species under a higher-taxon extrapolation
upward of 1 trillion microbial species under a scaling-law and lognormal-model framework
species delimitation requires explicit evidential criteria
